notes: Distances are from the Palisades Tahoe travel guide: Truckee 12 mi, Tahoe City 4.5 mi, Incline Village 16 mi.
Prices are not included; look them up per trip. 'To check' means pay timing and cancellation are not known yet.
Mountaineer is the free on-demand shuttle inside Olympic Valley, 7 am to 11 pm.

places.name: The Village at Palisades Tahoe Hotel
places.lift: Steps from the Funitel and Red Dog; ski-out, walk back
places.note: Kitchens, fireplaces and balconies; 8 outdoor hot tubs and underground parking. Check-in 4 pm. Costs the most.

places.name: Palisades Tahoe Lodge (was Squaw Valley Lodge)
places.lift: Ski-in/ski-out between the two gondolas; 5 min walk to the tram
places.note: 218 owner-owned condos, studios to 3 bedrooms, so decor and price vary by owner. Rented through the lodge's rental company and also on Airbnb.

places.name: Red Wolf Lodge
places.lift: Steps from Red Dog chair; 5 min walk to the Village
places.note: Ski-in/ski-out condos with kitchens, fireplaces, hot tub and covered parking. Guests get lift-ticket discounts.

places.name: Everline Resort & Spa
places.lift: Ski-in/ski-out by its own chairlift; far end from the Village
places.pay: Points at booking, plus a 1-night card deposit
places.note: Hyatt Category 8. Closed Nov 2-23, 2026, reopens before Thanksgiving. Shuttle to the Village.

places.name: PlumpJack Inn
places.lift: Reddit: closest to the tram
places.note: 55 rooms. Free cancel until 6 pm 7 days before check-in (14 days on holidays), then you lose the deposit.

places.name: Olympic Village Inn
places.lift: About a 5 min walk to the lifts, plus free shuttle
places.note: Condo-style units, pool, hot tubs. Reddit says it is the furthest of the base-area lodges.

places.name: Tavern Inn condos
places.lift: Short walk or shuttle; not ski-in
places.note: Budget-friendlier, roomy layouts, fireplaces, pool and hot tub.

places.name: Everline suites and Ridge Court townhomes (Marriott Homes & Villas)
places.lift: Everline suites are ski-in/ski-out; Ridge Court is 5 min by car
places.note: Marriott lists some Everline suites (sleep 4) and Ridge Court townhomes (3 bedrooms, 6 guests). Ask whether Bonvoy points work on these.

places.name: Valley View Townhome #10 (VRBO)
places.lift: 10 min walk, or 3 min on the free Mountaineer shuttle
places.note: Townhome with ski racks and laundry.

places.name: KT22 View (VRBO)
places.lift: Half a mile to the tram; Mountaineer shuttle
places.note: 3 bedrooms, sleeps 8, no pets.

places.name: Cozy Mountain Chalet (Airbnb)
places.lift: Mountaineer shuttle picks up at the door
places.note: 3 bedrooms, wood stove, 10 min to Tahoe City.

places.name: Basecamp Tahoe City
places.lift: Drive, about 15-20 min; free shuttle or Park & Ride
places.note: About 8 mi by road per the hotel. Rates from about $154 on Kayak. Pet friendly.

places.name: Pepper Tree Inn
places.lift: Drive, about 15-20 min
places.note: Reddit calls it the bargain hotel in Tahoe City.

places.name: evo Hotel Tahoe City
places.lift: Drive, about 15-20 min
places.note: From about $179 on Kayak.

places.name: SpringHill Suites Truckee
places.lift: Drive about 25 min on SR-89, longer in snow
places.note: All-suite, free hot breakfast, heated pool.

places.name: Martis Valley Lodge (Tapestry by Hilton)
places.lift: Within about 20 min of Palisades
places.note: 109 rooms, fire pits, hot tub. Near the SR-267 side of Truckee.

places.name: Hampton Inn and Home2 Suites Truckee
places.lift: Drive about 25 min
places.note: Hilton lists 5 Hampton hotels and a Home2 Suites in the Truckee listing. Home2 has free breakfast and an indoor pool. I haven't verified which are closest.

places.name: Best Western Plus Truckee-Tahoe Hotel
places.lift: Drive about 25 min
places.note: Mid-range, about 4.3 stars.

places.name: Gravity Haus Truckee-Tahoe
places.lift: Drive about 25 min
places.note: Highly rated, about 4.7 stars.

places.name: Hyatt Regency Lake Tahoe Resort, Spa and Casino
places.lift: Far; about 16 miles to Palisades
places.note: Only worth it if Hyatt points make it nearly free. Not close to the lifts.

title: Where to stay near Palisades
